definitions.gloss: bonus ticket; privilege coupon; perk voucher
definitions.explanation: A ticket or voucher that entitles the holder to a special benefit, bonus item, or extra service. Often distributed as part of promotions, loyalty programs, or with purchases.

examples.japanese: {特典券|とくてんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ドリンク→ドリンク：23507_dorinku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a free drink using a bonus ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特典券|とくてんけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

⟦{初回|しょかい}→初回：11780_shokai⟧⟦{購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}→購入者：25442_kounyuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特典券|とくてんけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついており、⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: First-time purchasers receive a bonus ticket that entitles them to a discount on their next purchase.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧ (special benefit, privilege, bonus) and ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket, voucher). Common in retail, entertainment, and membership contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特典券|とくてんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to distribute bonus tickets
- {特典券|とくてんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use a privilege coupon
- {特典券|とくてんけん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a bonus ticket included
- ⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧{特典券|とくてんけん}: attendance bonus ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割引券|わりびきけん}→割引券：09545_waribikiken⟧: discount coupon — specifically offers a price reduction
- ⟦{優待券|ゆうたいけん}→優待券：23292_yuutaiken⟧: complimentary ticket — a ticket offering preferential treatment, often from shareholding
- ⟦{引換券|ひきかえけん}→引換券：19009_hikikaeken⟧: exchange ticket — a voucher to be redeemed for a specific item
